applicability_rule: admissible iff predicted separation exceeds relevant correct plus wrong locked A2 fit-plus-floor allowances and E_num; no radial response is run before this preregistration is reviewed/frozen. For each spin, allocate the full D0 to each side conservatively.

iteration_provenance_control.definition: Use V from non-converged iteration 1 of same accepted SCF trajectory with accepted final P_out.
iteration_provenance_control.existing_capture_applicability: MISSING/UNASSESSED: accepted iteration-32 capture has no V_1; no applicability conclusion or KS M0 PASS until a valid same-trajectory replay supplies V_1 or the user approves a scope resolution.
iteration_provenance_control.predeclared_procedure: A diagnostic-only replay may use byte-identical accepted PRE and Fe seed, exact d91 source/executable and physical settings, changing only trace iteration selection to 1 in new scratch. Before any iteration-control calculate_pl/newrho replay, prove full 32-iteration convergence, exact accepted final Fe_out identity, matching charge/R05 history and final matrices. Then predeclare delta_s=Tr((V_1,s−V_in,s)P_out,s), x_1,s=Tr(V_1,sP_out,s)/q0_s and locked A_k; run only if applicable. If the trajectory cannot be established, iteration control remains MISSING/UNASSESSED and KS M0 cannot pass absent user-approved scope resolution. Any trajectory mismatch invalidates V_1.

numerical_guard.basis: RAW-minus-control response contains two independently guarded radial cases; ENERGY_TOL=1e-8 Ry per case, so propagate 2e-8 Ry. Existing matrix/control arithmetic cross-check is <=2e-12 Ry and is negligible at this scale. No new outcome inspected.

release_decision: Per root clarification, controls (a) and (b) may run because their predictions are frozen and independently approved; iteration control (c) applicability remains pending the exact d91 replay. Final KS M0 decision remains blocked on c eligibility.

spin_provenance_control.q2_policy: Recompute q2_local using the other-spin potential and locked captured P,M1,q0,c,q2.
